## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `go test ./... -race` pass
- [ ] If web sources changed: `web/dist` is rebuilt (`make web`) and committed
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour or commands changed
- [ ] Commit messages follow conventional style (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, ...)
- [ ] No secrets in code, logs, tests or screenshots
